project.description: Project id (or /api/v3/projects/{id} href). Alias of project_id. Maps to _links.project. Required for create|form_create (v1).

project_id.description: Project id. Alias of project. Maps to _links.project href /api/v3/projects/{id}. Required for create|form_create (v1).

principal.description: User/principal id (or /api/v3/users/{id} href). Aliases: user_id, principal_id. Maps to _links.principal. Required for create|form_create (v1; users only).

user_id.description: User id. Alias of principal. Maps to _links.principal href /api/v3/users/{id}.

principal_id.description: Principal id. Alias of principal. Maps to _links.principal href /api/v3/users/{id}.

roles.description: Role id(s) for the membership. Accepts array, comma-separated list, or JSON string of ids (e.g. [4] or "4" or "6"). Maps to _links.roles = [{href: /api/v3/roles/{id}}, …]. Default Member role id is 4; Project admin is typically 6. Required for create|form_create; optional for update|form_update (when present, replaces membership roles).

filters.description:
JSON specifying filter conditions.
Accepts the same format as returned by the [queries](https://www.openproject.org/docs/api/endpoints/queries/)
endpoint. Currently supported filters are:

+ any_name_attribute: filters memberships based on the name of the principal. All possible name variants
  (and also email and login) are searched.
+ blocked: reduces the result set to all memberships that are temporarily blocked or that are not blocked
  temporarily.
+ group: filters memberships based on the name of a group. The group however is not the principal used for
  filtering. Rather, the memberships of the group are used as the filter values.
+ name: filters memberships based on the name of the principal. Note that only the name is used which depends
  on a setting in the OpenProject instance.
+ principal: filters memberships based on the id of the principal.
+ project: filters memberships based on the id of the project.
+ role: filters memberships based on the id of any role assigned to the membership.
+ status: filters memberships based on the status of the principal.
+ created_at: filters memberships based on the time the membership was created.
+ updated_at: filters memberships based on the time the membership was updated last. (operations: list)

sortBy.description:
JSON specifying sort criteria.
Accepts the same format as returned by the [queries](https://www.openproject.org/docs/api/endpoints/queries/)
endpoint. Currently supported sorts are:

+ id: Sort by primary key
+ name: Sort by the name of the principal. Note that this depends on the setting for how the name is to be
  displayed at least for users.
+ email: Sort by the email address of the principal. Groups and principal users, which do not have an email,
  are sorted last.
+ status: Sort by the status of the principal. Groups and principal users, which do not have a status, are
  sorted together with the active users.
+ created_at: Sort by membership creation datetime
+ updated_at: Sort by the time the membership was updated last (operations: list)

_meta.description: {notificationMessage: any, sendNotification: boolean} (operations: create, form_create, update, form_update)

id.description: Membership id — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: delete, get, update, form_update)

confirmed.description: Optional. Two-Phase write confirm: set confirmed=true (or ja/yes/1) to execute POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE. Without it, mutating calls return a confirmation ask.
